title: Arunachal Police seeks search warrant against journalist Tongam Rina over anti-dam protest violence

ai.summary: Arunachal Pradesh Police sought search warrants against journalist Tongam Rina and others linked to anti-dam protest violence in Pasighat, where protesters vandalised and set fire to a power company office and police station on October 23.

facts.claim: Arunachal Pradesh Police sought search warrant against journalist Tongam Rina
facts.quote: The Arunachal Pradesh Police has sought a search warrant against journalist Tongam Rina in connection with the violence that broke out in Pasighat town during a protest against the Upper Siang dam project.

facts.claim: Protesters vandalised and set fire to a power company office and police station
facts.quote: The police had arrested 69 persons and detained four after protesters on October 23 vandalised and set fire to an office of the National Hydroelectric Power Corporation and a police station in Pasighat following the use of tear gas by security personnel during the agitation.

facts.claim: The protest was against the Upper Siang dam project
facts.quote: Several organisations have been protesting against the proposed 12,500-megawatt power project on the Siang river.

ai.background_note: The Upper Siang dam project, proposed by the Union government’s think-tank NITI Aayog in 2017, has faced opposition from local communities in Siang and Upper Siang districts, with 27 villages estimated to be affected.
